description:
4th November – “Food for Life” 🍽️❤️

In the true spirit of giving and sharing, Rtn. Kallolini & Kunjan Gandhi graciously organised a special lunch for 460 school children and their staff at the BMC School managed by the Akanksha Foundation, Tardeo, on 4th November at 11.30 am.

With the school closing for the Diwali holidays, the initiative was a wonderful way to spread festive cheer, bring smiles to young faces and make the last day of school extra special.

Beneficiaries: 460 school children

In Attendance: President Rtn. Amit Gupta, Rtn. Kallolini & Kunjan Gandhi and Rtn. Priya Rajpal.

Project cost Rs 51,000/-
